name: SAML 2.0 Auth Provider
description: Enables Single Sign-On via SAML 2.0 with any compliant Identity Provider including Okta, Azure AD, PingFederate, and Shibboleth
author: OnePlatform Examples

idpEntityId.description: The Identity Provider's SAML entity ID (used to verify the Issuer element in SAML responses)

idpSsoUrl.description: The IdP's Single Sign-On URL where AuthnRequests are sent (must use HTTPS)

idpCertificate.description: The IdP's X.509 signing certificate in PEM format for response signature verification

spEntityId.description: This Service Provider's entity ID (included in AuthnRequests and verified against AudienceRestriction)

emailAttributeName.description: SAML attribute name containing the user's email address

groupAttributeName.description: SAML attribute name containing the user's group memberships for role mapping

roleMapping.description: Map of IdP group names to OnePlatform RBAC role names

clockSkewToleranceSeconds.description: Acceptable clock drift in seconds for assertion time validation

requiredCredentials.name: privateKey
requiredCredentials.description: Optional SAML signing key for AuthnRequest signatures (PEM format). Required only if the IdP mandates signed requests.
